production-launch.rationale: The keyboard-accessible title action and direct route launch the same deterministic production scenario without requiring the development scenario driver.

canonical-setup.rationale: The fixed-seed AI-free setup supplies the completed launcher, power, sensors, opposing Bastions, exact targets, canonical preflight, and deterministic reconstruction.

authoritative-loop.rationale: Projectile IDs bind to their launch stage and only ordered Compact batteryGun impacts from the selected launcher within tolerance can score.

direction-comprehension.rationale: Panel, minimap, instructions, and whole-ring copy consistently contrast the 800 m spinward short shot with the 1,800 m antispinward long shot.

input-observation.rationale: Pointer and immediate keyboard minimap firing complete the range while whole-ring command isolation and tactical target restoration remain intact.

presentation-accessibility.rationale: The reviewed desktop and narrow layouts remain unobstructed, modal isolation is explicit, and live announcements occur only on meaningful state transitions.

lifecycle-regression.rationale: Save and load reject before storage mutation, retry preserves Low quality and saved data, disposal removes all owners, and full-check and core-match pass.

polish.summary: Label active progress as Stage 1 of 2 or Stage 2 of 2 if later observation finds the current fraction ambiguous.
polish.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if player or accessibility review demonstrates that active-stage progress is interpreted as completed-impact count.

polish.summary: Add conflicting mode and scenario route tests plus a built-preview launch smoke test.
polish.reopenTrigger: Reopen if conflicting route parameters launch unintended content or the production bundle cannot enter Gravity Range.

polish.summary: Increase narrow-panel secondary and button typography if more vertical space becomes available.
polish.reopenTrigger: Reopen if target-device inspection or user testing finds the compact copy or controls difficult to read.
